title: Legion Current-Run Pointer
description: Pointer to the most recently started `citadel run` (.claude/state/legion-runs/current-run.json), written by tools/legion_run_state.init_run. Read-only tools (worker_status, statusline) use it to locate live run state without an explicit --run-id.

task.description: The task string this run is executing.

started_at.description: Float epoch seconds (time.time()) at run start — NOT a date-time string.
